title: numbox review findings file
description: One file per (target x dimension) review unit. Written to findings/<DIM>/<target>.json.

summary.description: 1-3 sentences: overall state of this target on this dimension; explicitly note if clean (no findings)

findings.description: may be empty (a clean unit is a valid, valuable result)

title.description: short imperative-free description of the issue

file.description: repo-relative path of the offending code

lines.description: line number or range, e.g. 120 or 120-135

claim.description: the concrete defect and the failure it causes (wrong result / leak / crash / UB / etc.). Be specific about WHEN it triggers.

evidence.description: the actual code (quoted) or the precise reasoning chain that grounds the claim. Must reference code you read this session — never an assumed API.

recommendation.description: concrete fix; cite the canonical helper/pattern if one exists
